consent_text: We ask a few questions to give you the right information. We do not share your answers with training centres. You can ask us to delete your data at any time. If the learner is under 18, a parent or guardian must agree.
profile_concern_title: What worries you about vocational training?
profile_income_desc: This helps us show the right support. You can skip.
summary_ranking_rule: Ranking rule: we match learner interests to trades, then check eligibility by education level.
summary_no_trades: No trades matched. Please go back and select interests.
chat_engine_fallback: I don't have that specific data, but I can connect you with someone who does.
escalation_desc: A counsellor will call you back. We will share a summary so you won't need to repeat yourself.
escalation_success: Request sent. A counsellor will contact you soon.
sentiment_start_q: How do you feel about vocational training right now?
trade_no_providers: No demo providers found for your selected city.
trade_nsqf_body: The National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) is India's national credit framework. Each level represents a step up in skills. Level 4 is the entry for most ITI trades. You can move up through further training or education. Higher NSQF levels open doors to supervisory and degree-entry roles.
trade_state_fallback: No district data found. Showing state-level data.
compare_pick_prompt: Pick both trades above to see side-by-side data.
calc_subtitle: 3-year illustrative earnings: vocational route vs continuing general studies
calc_general_pay: Monthly pay if continuing general studies (Rs)
calc_formula: Formula: Vocational earnings = Starting pay x (36 - Duration) - Course cost. General earnings = General monthly pay x 36.
calc_disclaimer: Illustrative estimate from demonstration data and your inputs. Not a financial guarantee.
calc_vocational_formula: Vocational estimate = (monthly starting pay × (36 − course duration in months)) − course cost
calc_general_formula: General study estimate = (general study annual earnings × 3)
calc_result_label: Result label: Illustrative estimate from demonstration data and your inputs.

home_empty_recommendations: Share learner interests to see relevant pathways here.

card_trust_explanation: This is labelled demonstration data with a source, year, sample size and data-type label. It is not a verified public claim.
dashboard_resistance_formula: Formula: 70 × escalated-session rate + 30 × (5 − average recorded post-counselling sentiment) ÷ 4. If no post-counselling ratings exist, only the escalation component is used.
dashboard_empty_widget: No family sessions to show yet. This view will fill in as counselling sessions are recorded.
